speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Summit reached. Five thousand meters. Atmospheric containment failing. We are inside the Void Singularity Chamber.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Summit reached. Five thousand meters. Atmospheric containment failing. We are inside the Void Singularity Chamber.

speaker: SURYA
text: That event horizon is bending the light around the dais. Stay behind my bulwark. The radiation is climbing.
subtitle: SURYA: That event horizon is bending the light around the dais. Stay behind my bulwark. The radiation is climbing.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: He is draining the planetary geothermal grid into that core. One command, and he could purge the civilian population.
subtitle: OCEANUS: He is draining the planetary geothermal grid into that core. One command, and he could purge the civilian population.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: No guards. No drone army. Just him, waiting on that throne. He knew we would make it this far.
subtitle: MIRAGE: No guards. No drone army. Just him, waiting on that throne. He knew we would make it this far.

speaker: TITAN
text: We broke his tanks, his labs, and his fortress. Let him wait. That crown is coming off today.
subtitle: TITAN: We broke his tanks, his labs, and his fortress. Let him wait. That crown is coming off today.

speaker: AURA
text: Beneath all that noise, I can hear them. Millions of people down below, still holding on. Still singing for the dawn.
subtitle: AURA: Beneath all that noise, I can hear them. Millions of people down below, still holding on. Still singing for the dawn.

speaker: VOID COMMANDER
text: You crawled out of the scrap heaps to kneel before me. Your insurrection ends here. Axiom Force dies tonight.
subtitle: VOID COMMANDER: You crawled out of the scrap heaps to kneel before me. Your insurrection ends here. Axiom Force dies tonight.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Phase blades ready. Shields synchronized. Every scar brought us here. We finish this together.
subtitle: MIRAGE: Phase blades ready. Shields synchronized. Every scar brought us here. We finish this together.

speaker: KAITO
text: For every stolen name, every life the machine took. Axiom Force, draw your weapons. Strike down the Commander.
subtitle: KAITO: For every stolen name, every life the machine took. Axiom Force, draw your weapons. Strike down the Commander.
